create.name: Brooklyn Zen Center
create.bio:
Brooklyn Zen Center is a Soto Zen community in New York City, founded in 2005 as the first centre in Shunryu Suzuki's lineage in New York. Its in-person home, Boundless Mind Temple, shares space with Christ Church Cobble Hill, in its parish building on Clinton Street, and an online zendo that began during the pandemic now serves members across many locations. Its two Dharma teachers are Sarah Dojin Emerson, who trained at Tassajara and other San Francisco Zen Center sites for a decade, and Charlie Korin Pokorny, ordained by Reb Anderson, who also teaches graduate classes for the Institute of Buddhist Studies.

Zazen and a short service run online on weekday mornings, and a Saturday programme at the temple adds sitting and Dharma talks, with zazen instruction for newcomers on the first Saturday of each month. Retreats are held most months, from one-day sits to three-day sesshin and a five-day Rohatsu retreat in December, and classes study Zen texts, women ancestors and the precepts. The centre places strong weight on lay practice and social engagement, running a range of engaged practice groups, uses a sliding-scale pricing model and publishes a podcast of its Dharma talks.

courses.title: Five-Day Rohatsu Sesshin & Ango Closing Ceremony
courses.description: A five-day retreat at Boundless Mind Temple, led by Sarah Dojin Emerson and Charlie Korin Pokorny, marking the Buddha's awakening and closing the fall practice period. A minimum of three consecutive days is asked, and first-time retreatants are asked to speak with a teacher before registering.
courses.price: Sliding scale (Equitable Pricing Model); no one turned away for lack of funds

courses.title: Offerings: zazen, retreats and classes
courses.description: An overview of the centre's regular programme: zazen in person and online with periodic instruction, retreats almost every month from one day to five days, and practice-oriented classes led by senior students or a Dharma teacher.

free_resources.title: Brooklyn Zen Center Podcast
free_resources.description: Audio recordings of Dharma talks given at Boundless Mind Temple by the centre's teachers and guests, with short summaries, on subjects such as Dogen's teaching on Buddha-nature, koans from the Book of Serenity and the Hungry Ghost ceremony.

free_resources.title: Zen Practice
free_resources.description: An introduction to the centre's practice: zazen as just sitting following Dogen's Fukanzazengi, a short history of Soto Zen from Bodhidharma to Suzuki Roshi, the sixteen bodhisattva precepts and the practice of dana.
